name: workbench
description: Designs and reviews a page's UI and UX in the Workbench (`src/Workbench`) before it is built into the app: the page runs on the app's own bit BlazorUI components and theme with in-memory sample data, is checked on phones, tablets and desktops in light, dark and right-to-left with every data state, and is captured as pixel-exact screenshots, including App Store, Google Play and Microsoft Store images with a colored background and a caption. The user reviews it with comments pinned on the page that reach the agent as they are written, and whenever it runs the agent is connected to that review and listening. It is also where an agent shows a long task's progress, one task per chat, and asks the user what it needs, answered there with a click, a few words or their voice. Use when the user asks to run or open the Workbench, wants to design, mock up or prototype a page or a UI/UX idea, compare a page across devices, themes, languages or data states, make store screenshots, go through review comments left in the Workbench, bring one of the app's pages into the Workbench for screenshots, share a Workbench page as a link, has agreed to design a new page in the Workbench first, or is about to build a complex UI with no design behind it, and whenever a long task, like a first deployment or a new feature, should show its progress and ask the user on the Workbench's Progress page.
